svg.title: How much sharper could the test become?
svg.desc: Original Figure 2 current-data contour in gold, SO-like forecast in green and CMB-HD-like forecast in red, within the same nine-parameter model. The forecasts include mock DESI and assume current mean values persist.

g.text: Running, light relics and neutrino mass varied
Tilt ns · How fluctuation strength varies with scale
Contours: inner 1σ · outer 2σ. Zero running = no change in tilt.
Forecasts assume today's central values persist; not new data.
Adapted from Cheslog et al. (2026), Figure 2 · CC BY 4.0
